description: One order of any protocol leaf the producer holds — a LayerZero message by guid, an Across deposit, a Mayan order, an ERC-8183 job — its stages across chains, each with its transaction and its leaf under the superroot. Returns: { protocol, key, latest, final, stages, counts, src_chain, dst_chain, expect[] (what the register expects next and the reason if late), transitions[], anchor, verify }; 404 for an order the leaf has not seen. (GET /v1/protocol/:protocol/order/:key)

api_key.description: your tfr_ key (optional for keyless reads)
